For Loop

The one idea to landA for loop does not count. It walks a sequence and stops when the sequence runs out, so the only question worth asking is what is in this sequence. range(start, end) just builds one, and it stops before the end value. That is why the row you wanted is missing.

Recap: what stuck from while loops

Recap: what stuck from while loops

Recap

Last session: the while loop

How many times is the line while counter < 3 checked?

counter = 0
while counter < 3:
    print("hi")
    counter = counter + 1
  • 3 times
  • 4 times
  • 2 times
  • 1 time

4 times. It is asked before every pass, and once more at the end when counter is 3 and the answer is finally no.

What does this program do?

counter = 1
while counter < 4:
    print(counter)
  • Prints 1 2 3
  • Prints 1 for ever
  • Prints nothing
  • Shows an error

Prints 1 for ever. Nothing inside the loop changes counter, so the check never turns false.

What appears on the screen?

counter = 5
while counter < 3:
    print("hi")
    counter = counter + 1
  • hi three times
  • hi once
  • Nothing at all
  • An error

Nothing at all. 5 is not less than 3, so the body never runs even once. A program with no output is not a broken program.

🎵

Hook: one tap, and it keeps going

Hook: Play all

Before we start

One tap, and it keeps going

The listA music app you have all used. Five songs are in the list.

One tapYou tap Play all, one time. The first song starts.

It moves on its ownSong one ends. Song two starts. Nobody touched the phone.

Still goingSong three. Still nobody pressed anything.

Right to the endIt keeps going, song after song, down to the last one.

Then it stopsNowhere on this screen does it say five. So what told it to stop?

Add one songNow the list has six. It will play six. You changed nothing else.

So what is it doing?Strip the phone away and this is all that is left.

That is the whole idea. Take a list. Do one job. Once for each item in it. You never say how many.

Hands off keyboards We go one step at a time. Check your own row after each press.
Line 1 word now holds the two characters H and i.
Line 2 n starts at 0.
Line 3, first pass The loop takes the first item out of the sequence. ch is H.
Line 4 n goes from 0 to 1.
Line 5 It prints whatever ch is holding right now.
Line 3, second pass Back to the loop. It takes the next item. ch is i.
Line 4 n goes from 1 to 2.
Line 5 It prints i.
Line 3, third try The loop asks for the next item. There is none left, so the loop ends.
Line 6 2 is not more than 5, so line 7 is never reached. It stays grey.
Line 8 It prints n, which is 2. Two characters, two passes.

      Exit: one question
      Exit: one question
      Exit question
      Which one prints nothing?
      The app prints one line per free seat. For which pair does the screen show nothing at all?
      1seats = int(input())
2booked = int(input())
3left = seats - booked
4for i in range(1, left):
5    print("Seat", i)
      • seats = 5, booked = 3
      • seats = 4, booked = 3
      • seats = 3, booked = 0
      • seats = 6, booked = 2
      Option B. left is 1, so range(1, 1) is empty. The loop body never runs, and nothing is printed anywhere.
